column1: # repo<TAB>PR number<TAB>one-line fix. tools/render_bio_prs.py fills status from the GitHub API.

column3: `predict_query` no longer writes its options into the caller's query dict
Leading-decimal answers like `.701` keep their value when graded
Report summaries keep metrics whose scores are all 0
FDA adverse-event summaries count deaths and hospitalizations from the report-level flags
`query_openfda` sends its search, sort, count and skip parameters
Glob patterns match the whole file name (`*.fq` no longer matches `a.fq.gz`)
`generate-metadata` handles nf-core schema patterns that crashed it (55 to 124 of 146 pipelines)
Rollouts record a copy of each executed action, so a reused policy buffer can't change scores
Trial artifacts stay separate for scene IDs that differ only in case
Scan energy positions, explicit empty pKa element lists, and folder lookup past the first page
